title: Curator-driven profile synthesis with dataset fingerprinting and runner adapters
creator: Lucas Nguyen
description:
Problem: When onboarding a new model or a model variant (quantized, trimmed, etc.) we need reproducible, explainable performance profiles that feed the model registry's version-pin metadata. Current harness runs produce large ad-hoc artifacts and require manual combination of dataset samples, prompt scaffolds, and runner capabilities, which leads to inconsistent profiles and slow onboarding cycles.

Goal: Build a Curator component in the benchmark harness that automates profile synthesis by: 1) fingerprinting datasets and prompt sets, 2) generating weighted scenario folds based on workload heuristics, 3) validating runner compatibility via lightweight adapters, and 4) emitting canonical profile artifacts suitable for pinning and release gating. Profiles should be reproducible, traceable to inputs, and include cost/latency distributions and KV-cache behavior summaries.
acceptance_criteria: Curator binary (or orchestration job) can ingest dataset signatures and prompt scaffold manifests and produce a deterministic profile artifact for a given random seed.

Profile JSON schema includes: model_version, model_variant (quant/ops), dataset_fingerprint, prompt_set_id, scenario_weights, latency_percentiles (p50/p95/p99), per-token-cost-estimate, kv_cache_hit_simulation, runner_compat_matrix, and artifact provenance (commit + inputs).
Generated profiles can be consumed by the model registry to produce pinning metadata and are surfaced in the Console's profile catalog UI.
CI integration: a smoke run in main branch verifies artifact reproducibility (same seed -> identical profile JSON) and flags drift if inputs changed.
Runner adapters (shims) allow the Curator to detect unsupported runner features and mark scenarios as skipped with reasons; no hard failures for incompatible runners.
End-to-end example onboarding flow documented (Confluence link) and a sample PR that uses the Curator to onboard an internal model variant.
implementation_plan: Spike: implement dataset fingerprinting utility that computes stable ids from sample slices (SHA256 over canonicalized examples + schema) — 2d
Design: define profile JSON schema and provenance fields; align with model-registry and Console ingestors — 1d
Adapter work: implement a runner capability probe and lightweight adapter API (supports kv-cache, streaming, batch_size_max) — 3d
Sampling: implement weighted scenario sampler using workload heuristics (sequence length distribution, prefix reuse rates) and deterministic seeding — 3d
Integration: hook Curator into harness CI, emit artifacts to artifact store with manifest and checksums; add gating job for model-registry pin creation — 2d
Docs & example: write onboarding guide and add Console mapping for new profile metadata — 2d
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Dataset canonicalization might be brittle across ingesters. Mitigation: define strict normalization rules and include versioned normalizers in artifact provenance.
Risk: Runner capability matrix divergence (runners adding features) will cause skew. Mitigation: make adapter protocol extensible and include feature-negotiation in probes.
Risk: Developers rely on generated cost estimates as ground truth. Mitigation: mark cost estimates as guidance with confidence intervals and link to raw token/latency histograms.
Risk: Long-running runs blow CI budget. Mitigation: implement fast-mode sampling that produces a compact profile suitable for gating and a full-mode for nightly artifacts.
Risk: Backwards compatibility with existing profile consumers. Mitigation: include a translator that emits legacy fields and a compatibility flag in profile metadata.
manual_test_plan: Run Curator against small public dataset slice with seed=42 and confirm identical profile JSON on two separate runs
Simulate a runner missing kv-cache by forcing adapter response and confirm scenarios are marked skipped with explanatory message
Onboard a toy quantized variant and verify the model-registry receives profile and creates pin metadata in staging
Verify Console surface: profile appears in catalog with provenance link and latency histograms render
monitoring_and_metrics: Profile artifact size and number of scenarios
Number of adapter-detected incompatibilities per runner
Frequency of CI drift alerts (seed mismatch)

notes: Prefer implementing Curator as a standalone subcommand in the harness to allow local dev runs and CI jobs to call the same binary.
Profile artifacts should be content-addressed and signed by the CI job to ensure traceability for audits in Private deployments.
Consider adding a lightweight HTML profile preview stored alongside the JSON for quick Console rendering without heavy parsing on the frontend.
